Visit note | 2025-12-07 03:30 PM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Rozina Begum, 80, female. Mrs. Begum attends for review and mentions she has been constantly thirsty and losing weight without trying. She is a homemaker, and this was found during a routine test before a trip to Farmgate. She reports adherence to previous advice and denies blurred vision or foot sores. On examination: fasting glucose 8.6 mmol/L, BP 118/72 mmHg, pulse 75 bpm, weight 89 kg. Systemic examination is unremarkable. Assessment: Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to reduce rice portions and sweets, walk briskly 30 minutes five days a week, check fasting sugar twice weekly, and check the feet daily. Follow-up in 3 months with HbA1c.

Visit note | 2025-12-07 03:30 PM | Dr. Anisur Rahman, Ophthalmology | Patient: Farzana Karim, 28, female. Mrs. Karim returns for review and reports her eyelids are stuck together in the morning along with sticky yellow discharge. She works as an office cleaner and notes the issue began after swimming at a public pool in Mirpur. She has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She denies severe eye pain or changes in vision. On examination: visual acuity 6/6 in the left eye, BP 135/74 mmHg, pulse 77 bpm, weight 63 kg. Conjunctival injection and purulent discharge are present. Assessment: Bacterial conjunctivitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to wash hands often, do not share towels, and stay away from work for two days. Follow-up in 1 week if not better.
